title: Brand Surface Studies
description: Five independent studies that turn artist identity into kit-adjacent surfaces such as press folders, social cards, credential objects, and emblem walls.
creative_direction: Independent assets should feel like parts of a believable music press kit: clean portrait-supporting layouts, emblem studies, credential objects, and launch collateral. Avoid literal readable logos; imply a brand system through shape, material, and hierarchy.
